hook: Viral RNA from Ebola-family viruses is detected by PCR directly in 2 microliters of blood

readout.label: Detection level for Ebola-family RNA in blood

summary: By combining blood-tolerant chemistry, RNase inhibition and longer-wavelength fluorescence, the authors ran qPCR without extracting nucleic acid first. They detected hepatitis B DNA and RNA of hepatitis C, Bundibugyo, Ebola and Sudan viruses, with a portable instrument giving results in an hour. Tests used blood spiked with nucleic acid standards, not intact virus or patient samples.
title: Direct Whole-Blood PCR for Molecular Diagnostics
